criteria.title: Factual correctness
criteria.description: Does the answer correctly reflect the key concepts/facts in the selected textbook section?

levels.description: No correct facts present; answer contains multiple factual errors or is entirely off-topic.
One or two correct facts present; the large majority of key facts are missing or wrong.
Several correct facts present but significant errors or omissions remain; fewer than half the key facts are accurate.
Most key facts are correct with a few notable errors or omissions; roughly half to two-thirds of key facts are addressed accurately.
All major facts are correct with at most one minor error or omission; no misleading statements.
All key facts are correct, precise, and fully supported by the section; no errors, contradictions, or omissions.

criteria.title: Coverage of section scope
criteria.description: Did the answer cover the relevant parts of the ToC section (and any included subsections)?

levels.description: Answer addresses none or only one peripheral topic from the section; the core content is entirely absent.
Answer touches on 1–2 topics from the section but leaves most major areas completely unaddressed.
Answer covers roughly half the section's main topics; several important parts are still missing.
Answer covers the majority of the section's main topics with only minor gaps in secondary content.
Answer addresses nearly all major topics in the section; only minor or peripheral details are missing.
Answer comprehensively covers all major topics and relevant sub-topics of the section with no meaningful gaps.

criteria.title: Use of section-specific terminology/structure
criteria.description: Does the answer incorporate relevant terms, definitions or structure from the textbook section?

levels.description: No section-specific terms, definitions, or structural elements used; answer relies entirely on generic everyday language.
One or two section-specific terms appear but the answer is mostly described in vague or informal language.
Some correct terminology present but used inconsistently or with incomplete or imprecise definitions.
Most important terms are used correctly; minor gaps in precision or a small number of key terms are missed.
All major terms and structural elements from the section are used correctly and precisely throughout.
Complete, precise, and consistent use of all section-specific terminology and structural frameworks; definitions are exact.

criteria.title: Explanation and logical coherence
criteria.description: Is the answer logically organized, flows well, and explains rather than just listing facts?

levels.description: No logical organisation; answer is a random list of keywords or fragments with no explanatory thread.
Minimal structure; answer attempts some explanation but reasoning is unclear or jumps between unrelated points.
Some logical flow present but explanations are shallow; transitions between ideas are abrupt or missing.
Generally well-organised with coherent explanations; a few transitions or elaborations could be clearer or deeper.
Clear, logical structure throughout; ideas flow naturally and explanations are well-developed with smooth transitions.
Exceptionally coherent; ideas are explained deeply, linked explicitly, and flow in a way that reflects true structural understanding.

criteria.title: Depth of understanding and application
criteria.description: Does the answer go beyond surface-level recall — explaining why/how things work, connecting ideas, or applying the concept to an example?

levels.description: Answer restates definitions or phrases verbatim; no explanation of mechanisms, causes, or relationships between ideas.
Shows minimal understanding beyond recall; one or two why/how points are mentioned but not developed or explained.
Some depth present; partial explanation of a mechanism or a limited connection between two concepts, but not sustained.
Demonstrates solid understanding; explains key mechanisms and draws at least one meaningful connection between concepts in the section.
Clear evidence of deep understanding; explains multiple mechanisms, connects ideas across the section, or applies a concept to a concrete example.
Exceptional depth; independently synthesises ideas, identifies non-obvious connections, or applies concepts beyond what the section states explicitly.

interpretation.23-25: Mastery: Answer is accurate, comprehensive, well-explained, and clearly grounded in the section.
interpretation.15-22: Proficient: Good work with some gaps in coverage, precision, or depth that could be improved.
interpretation.0-14: Needs Review: Significant omissions or errors, weak explanation, or insufficient grounding in this section.
